question: India shares its land boundary with ______ in the north-west.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

India shares its border with seven countries-

__
 
• Afghanistan and Pakistan to the North-West,
 
• China, Bhutan and Nepal to the North,
 
• Myanmar and Bangladesh to the East.
 
• Length of the land frontier of India is 15,200 km.
